candidate.applies_to: versus_captured_output and versus_identity_replay comparisons for every layout; identity comparisons are trivially exact against themselves

identity_versus_captured.strict_equivalence_note: enforced via max_abs_error <= atol on the identity-versus-captured comparison, which at rtol=0 is exactly equivalent to zero isclose failures under the strict bound

empty_fence_diagnostic.semantics: GPU-0 same-clock empty interval after untimed NCCL start alignment through completion of one NCCL reduce

execution.combine: DeepEP Buffer.combine with Buffer.capture previous_event and completion_event.current_stream_wait
execution.runner: SGLang DeepGemmRunnerCore contiguous FP8 grouped GEMM

timing_config.schedule_algorithm: random.Random(seed + block).shuffle over the frozen timed layout order (base + twelve residual candidates; identity is never timed)

timing_semantics.diagnostic: no separate diagnostic pass in the stopping execution protocol
timing_semantics.primary: GPU-0 same-clock completion-fenced block after untimed NCCL start alignment; no fence subtraction
